note: Source review: MAX_OUTPUT_PIXELS is enforced only after appending a nonduplicate frame. stitch_frames validates/clones the first frame and returns it without checking that pixel cap. A single 8192x4097 frame is within per-side limits but exceeds MAX_OUTPUT_PIXELS. Reject over-budget frame geometry before allocation/clone and add a metadata-only regression that does not allocate a huge RGBA buffer; preserve existing valid-frame errors/behavior where possible. P65 small-buffer tests currently pass but do not cover this boundary.
